TextDisplay.text:
As a hacker,
you are armed with only two weapons:

The Vectors.
You straddle the boundary between the Analog and Digital world,\n\nand you possess both an Analog and Digital Vector.
The right trigger is the Analog Vector.\n\nThe left trigger is the Digital Vector.

To fire:

Hold the trigger,
Target multiple enemies,
Then release.
To get bigger combos, target more enemies at once.
There are both Analog and Digital enemies.
Analog enemies are darker with solid faces,\n\nDigital enemies are lighter with wireframe faces.

Attack enemies with the OPPOSITE weapon to:

DOUBLE the damage.
INCREASE the score.
As you hit more enemies, your overdrive bar for each Vector will start to fill.
When each bar fills up, you will earn one overdrive for that Vector.
You have been given three overdrives for the Digital Vector.
Press the Left Bumper to activate the MEGA DRIVE and hit many enemies at once.
You have been given three overdrives for the Analog Vector.
Press the Right Bumper to activate the FREEZE DRIVE and freeze time for a moment.
At the end of each zone is a Routing Node.
Destroy it to gain information and sink deeper into the network.
Congratulations! Now feel the pulse and dive in...
